summary: Hernando County tower of 100 ft steel, reported in Sept 1936 as ready for inspection; no later record of the tower found.

access.note: Day-use area inside Withlacoochee State Forest; the listed day-use fee applies to all day users. No source describes the tower itself.

visit.trail_note: Day-use area with trailheads, picnic areas, grills and restrooms. No source says whether the tower remains.

events.note: Tampa Times report, Sept. 21, 1936 (quoted on Forest Lookouts): tower announced as ready for public inspection about Wednesday; first of five towers in the project. Completion is reported, not confirmed by a later source.

notes_for_editor: Built date rests on one 1936 newspaper report quoted by Forest Lookouts; no later source confirms completion. Record height 30.5 m matches the 100 ft in that report. Fate and current tower status are unknown; no source found says whether any structure remains. A 'Fire Tower Trailhead' name appeared only in a search summary, not a fetched page, so it is not used. Komoot and Wanderlog are recreation listings. Record agency and ownership not changed; Withlacoochee is state forest land per Wikipedia (Florida Board of Forestry since 1958).
